bibl.title: Palm Sunday
Hymn 57 on the Reception of Our Saviour Jesus Christ

noteGrp.note: A Syriac liturgical hymn for Palm Sunday interpreting Christ’s entry into Jerusalem in light of his voluntary Passion and Resurrection. The colt, palm and olive branches, and the praise of the children become signs of the saving work that culminates in the cross and resurrection. This is hymn 57, the final hymn in Brooks’s Palm Sunday sequence.
